title: post api unison search with valid FIND query
description: POST /api/unison/search with body containing searches array with one FIND operator on facet DATASET (or first available facet), keyword test, empty filters, options maxDepth 1 includeCounts true. Expect HTTP 200 and JSON success true with results object.

title: get api unison search returns method not allowed
description: GET /api/unison/search must return 405 (or documented not-allowed) with JSON body; no server crash.

title: post api unison search rejects empty searches
description: POST /api/unison/search with JSON searches: [] or missing searches. Expect 400 or JSON success false with error message.

title: post api unison search rejects NOT as first operator
description: POST /api/unison/search where first search item has operator NOT. Expect logical error: success false or 400 per UnisonSearchService rules.

title: get UnisonSearch filter-fields requires facetId
description: GET /UnisonSearch/api/filter-fields without facetId query parameter. Expect 400 Bad Request.

title: get UnisonSearch filter-fields for DATASET returns metadata
description: GET /UnisonSearch/api/filter-fields?facetId=DATASET returns 200 and JSON array or object of filter field definitions.

title: get UnisonSearch api defaults for grid columns
description: GET /UnisonSearch/api/defaults returns 200 and JSON with top-level facets array (UNISON_DEFAULTS from app_config); each facet has id and activeFields as used by search-columns.js.

title: post unison search with searchFields restriction
description: POST /api/unison/search with FIND and searchFields map e.g. name true ref false. Expect 200 success true; response structure consistent with FacetResult.

title: get active tasks for search facet context
description: GET /api/active-tasks (used by search UI Active Tasks). Document status code 200 with list or 401 if auth required in environment.

title: get people search autocomplete endpoint
description: GET /UnisonSearch/api/people/search?query=a&limit=5 returns 200 JSON (may be empty list) without 500.
